answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The comet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work.
